• Migliorano il benessere dei pazienti intraprendendo varie attività con loro, come bere un caffè, leggere ad alta voce, passeggiare o giocare
• Parlano con i pazienti, hanno un orecchio aperto e sono lì per loro Requisiti:
• Sono una personalità allegra e socievole e possono facilmente avvicinarsi alle persone bisognose di aiuto e assistenza
• Sono impegnati, affidabili e responsabili
• Sono in grado di svolgere incarichi regolari

Spital con i suoi 170 posti letto e i suoi collaboratori in tutto il paese e le regioni limitrose. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bülach Hospital is growing - grow with it. Tasks:
• You support the hospital staff free of charge through various tasks such as personal care and therapy support
• You improve the well-being of patients by undertaking various activities with them, such as drinking coffee, reading aloud, walking or playing games
• You talk to patients, have an open ear and are there for them Requirements:
• You are a cheerful and sociable personality and can approach people in need of help and care well
• You are committed, reliable and responsible
• You are able to perform regular assignments
• You speak German well
• You are interested in the hospital operation and would like to get to know the hospital Bülach in all its facets We offer: P1-oeV.svg, P2 catering.svg, P3-benefits.svg, P6-health promotion.svg, P7-working time.svg, P8- and further training.svg, P11-value assessment.svg, P13-kaffeepause.svg The hospital Bülach with its 170 beds and around 1,200 employees ensures the medical care of 180,000 people in the Zurich region and the surrounding regions.
